notes.title: 🎮 Development Update: Police and Justice System Implemented! 🚔⚖️
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We’re excited to share a major new feature with you: we've just implemented a [b]police and justice system[/b] that will bring a whole new layer of realism and strategy to the game. You’ll need to carefully manage your criminal operations, as law enforcement investigations and trials are now a constant threat. Here’s a detailed breakdown of how this new system works and how it will impact your gameplay:

[b]🔍 Police Attention and Secret Investigations[/b]
Every crime your mafia family commits increases the level of police attention. Once the attention reaches a certain threshold, the police will [b]secretly launch an investigation[/b] into the most active members of your organization. Up to four of your most notorious members could be under scrutiny.

[list]
[*] [b]The number of members investigated depends on the scale of your criminal activity[/b]—the more aggressive you are, the higher the chance that multiple members will be under investigation.
[*] The investigation lasts [b]one in-game year[/b], after which the police will carry out a [b]raid[/b].
[/list]

[b]🚨 The Raid: Arrests and Seizures[/b]
Once the investigation concludes, the police will conduct a raid. All members under investigation will be [b]arrested[/b] and sent to [b]Randall’s Island Prison[/b].

[list]
[*] [b]Lost Zones[/b]: If any of the arrested members were controlling a zone, that territory will be lost and will revert to neutral status, open for other families to seize.
[*] [b]Money Seized[/b]: Along with the arrests, the police will confiscate a portion of your [b]dirty money[/b]. The amount seized depends on how many members were arrested—the more arrests, the greater the financial loss.
[/list]

[b]💼 Legal Expenses: Play Your Cards in Court[/b]
Once your made men are arrested, you’ll have to make a critical decision: how much are you willing to [b]invest in legal defense[/b] to save them?

[list]
[*] At this stage, you’ll be prompted to decide how much you want to [b]spend on lawyers[/b]. The more you invest, the higher the chances your men will be [b]acquitted[/b] at trial.
[*] Legal expenses scale with the number of arrested members—if several men are arrested, you’ll need to invest more to increase your chances of success.
[/list]

[b]⚖️ The Trial: Discover the Fate of Your Men[/b]
One month after the raid, the [b]trial[/b] will take place, and you’ll learn the fate of your arrested men.

[list]
[*] If you’ve invested enough in legal defense, there’s a chance they’ll be [b]acquitted[/b]. In this case, your men will return to the family, and you’ll recover the [b]seized money[/b]. However, any zones lost during the arrests will remain neutral and must be reconquered.
[*] If the defense fails, your men will be [b]convicted[/b]. Once convicted, they’ll spend the rest of their lives in prison and will no longer be available to manage the family’s operations.
[/list]

[b]👤 The Risk of Informants: Betrayal from Within[/b]
There’s another risk to consider. During the investigation, one of your men might turn [b]informant[/b] and cooperate with the police.

[list]
[*] The chance of betrayal depends on the [b]wiseguy tax[/b]: the higher the tax, the more likely it is that one of your men will break under pressure and cooperate with law enforcement.
[*] If one of your men becomes an informant, their testimony will be [b]damning[/b]: all arrested members will be convicted [b]without exception[/b]. But you won’t know if there’s an informant until the trial, adding a layer of tension and uncertainty.
[/list]

[b]🏢 Special Buildings: Police Station and Prison[/b]
This is where two key buildings come into play: the [b]Police Station[/b] and the [b]Prison[/b].

[list]
[*] [b]Police Station[/b]: If you control the local police station, you’ll be able to gather intelligence on ongoing investigations. This allows you to find out [b]which family members are under investigation[/b] and, by bribing corrupt officers, you can even learn the identity of an informant (if there is one). Knowing in advance who’s betraying you can be critical to your strategy.
[*] [b]Prison[/b]: If you discover that one of your men has turned informant, controlling the prison becomes essential. You’ll be able to attempt to [b]eliminate the informant[/b] before they testify against you. However, this is a risky move—if the assassination attempt fails, police attention on your family will increase significantly, leading to further investigations and arrests.
[*] [b]Courtroom[/b]: Owning it, you are going to have a bonus on acquitted chances.
[/list]


[b]🗣️ We Want Your Feedback![/b]
This new police and justice mechanic adds a fresh layer of challenge to managing your mafia family. You’ll need to carefully balance your criminal activities, keep an eye on law enforcement, and plan how to defend your men if things go south.

We’d love to hear your thoughts on this new system! Do you have any suggestions, adjustments, or improvements you'd like to see? [b]Let us know your feedback and ideas[/b]—your input is crucial in making the game even more engaging and strategic!

Thank you, as always, for your support!

[b]The Development Team[/b]

notes.title: 🎮 Development Update: Map System Implemented! 🌆🗺️
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We’re excited to announce the implementation of a key feature: the [b]map system[/b]. This addition introduces a whole new layer of depth and strategy as you expand your criminal empire throughout New York City. Here's a detailed breakdown of how the map works and the strategic opportunities it brings.

[h3][b]🗽 The Map: Control New York City[/b][/h3]
The game map is based on [b]New York City[/b], divided into its [b]five major boroughs[/b]:
[list]
[*] [b]Manhattan[/b]
[*] [b]Brooklyn[/b]
[*] [b]Queens[/b]
[*] [b]Bronx[/b]
[*] [b]Staten Island[/b]
[/list]
Each borough is further divided into [b]zones[/b], representing specific areas of each borough. These zones can be [b]controlled[/b] by one of the [b]five Mafia Families[/b]. Controlling zones is key to expanding your family's power and increasing your profits.

[h3][b]💰 Zone Control and Income[/b][/h3]
Each zone under your control generates [b]regular income[/b] from [b]rackets[/b] and [b]illegal betting[/b] operations.
Each business within a zone can be extorted, allowing you to [b]demand protection money[/b], boosting your family’s revenue.
Alternatively, instead of extortion, you can [b]buy out businesses[/b] and use them as fronts to [b]launder dirty money[/b]. This lets you turn your illegal earnings into clean cash, crucial for growing your operations.

[h3][b]👤 Made Men and Zone Management[/b][/h3]
You can assign a [b]made man[/b] to each zone. Depending on their [b]skills[/b], they will provide [b]operational bonuses[/b], such as increasing income or improving defense for the zone they manage.
Zones are defended by [b]soldiers[/b], who protect your territory from rival families. These soldiers are paid a [b]fixed monthly salary[/b].

[h3][b]⚔️ Conquering Zones[/b][/h3]
To expand your empire, you can attack zones controlled by other families. To conquer a zone, you must [b]eliminate all guards[/b] defending it. Once cleared, the zone becomes part of your territory, and you can start collecting profits from its illegal activities.

[h3][b]🏢 Special Buildings[/b][/h3]
Certain zones contain [b]special buildings[/b] that offer unique strategic advantages to the family controlling them:

[list]
[*] [b]Police Station[/b]: Gain access to [b]critical information[/b] on ongoing investigations against your family and uncover if there are any [b]informants[/b] among your ranks. This knowledge allows you to take proactive steps to avoid arrests and convictions.
[*]   
[*] [b]Prison[/b]: Control the prison to interact with [b]incarcerated made men[/b]. If you suspect one of them is a snitch, you can attempt to [b]eliminate them[/b] before they testify against you, but be cautious: if the attempt fails, it will increase law enforcement attention.
[*] 
[*] [b]Courthouse[/b]: Provides a [b]bonus to acquittal chances[/b] during legal trials involving your family. This building is crucial to avoiding long prison sentences for your men.
[*] 
[*] [b]Port and Airport[/b]: These buildings unlock the [b]drug trafficking[/b] feature, allowing you to organize shipments of drugs and [b]set the price[/b] for other families. Controlling the port allows for larger shipments, significantly boosting your profits from the international drug trade.
[/list]
[h3][b]🔮 Future Implementations[/b][/h3]
We are working on several future updates that will make the game even more immersive and strategic. Here are some ideas we are currently considering:

[b]Special Businesses[/b]: In the future, you will be able to build [b]commercial properties[/b] such as casinos, racetracks, and other high-income establishments, providing additional revenue streams and money laundering opportunities.

[b]Map Expansion[/b]: We’re considering expanding the map to include parts of [b]New Jersey[/b], adding more zones for you to conquer and control.

[b]New Features[/b]: We’re also exploring new game mechanics, including [b]political corruption systems[/b] and other advanced strategic elements.

[h3][b]🗣️ We Want Your Feedback![/b][/h3]
We’re excited to see how the new [b]map system[/b] changes the way you manage your Mafia family. As always, [b]your feedback is key[/b] to making the game even better!

What do you think of the balance between [b]zones, income, and defense[/b]? Does the system offer enough challenges, or are there areas you'd like to see improved? Do you have any ideas or suggestions for future implementations?

Let us know your thoughts in the comments or community discussion forums! Your input will help us refine the game and make it even more engaging.

Thank you for your continued support!

[b]The Development Team[/b]
